## Game 01: Subsetting Lists

```{r}
campus = jsonlite::fromJSON(
  "https://isa401-find-your-seat.vercel.app/campus.json")   # find my seat on campus

names(campus)   #shows names to find name for farmer

fsb = campus$Farmer   #saves a name for farmer, equivelent of 
fsb$code    #gets code for farmer

names(fsb)
names(fsb$floors)
fsb$floors$'2'$sections      # shows 80 sections on floor 2 

sec_floor <- fsb$floors$'2'
sec_floor_rooms <- sec_floor$rooms  # open data frame to see 2050 has 11 ISA sections 

```

## Reading The Excel File

```{r}
occupation = readxl::read_excel(
  path = "../data/occupation.xlsx",
  sheet = 5, # sheet = "Table 1.4"
  skip = 1
)

# '-' when you subset in R, drops these specific things
# given that they are multiple, I put them in a vector
# notice the "," after the parantheses
# nothing after the comma which means all columns
# instead of that space --> 1:7
occupation = occupation[-c(32,33,34), ]
# alternatively
# occupation = occupation[1:31, ]
```

## Reading JSON Data

```{r}
json_url = "https://data.cincinnati-oh.gov/resource/rvmt-pkmq.json?$limit=100"
crashes_json = jsonlite::fromJSON(json_url)
dplyr::glimpse(crashes_json)
```

## Game 2
